name: Mikura Ena
source:
She has protected her virginity so she could give it to Shun. She Appears as a weathercaster on an early morning information program.

She is a weather girl who has won a beauty contest at her university.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/moe_hina/kikenbiok/index.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
她守护贞操，只为将其交给瞬。她在清晨的资讯节目中担任天气预报员。

她是天气小姐，曾在大学赢得选美比赛。
